name: ziplume
description: Make it. Link it. Share it.

paragraphs: QR codes, short links, and simple sharing tools: links, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone and SMS, plus trackable codes with scan analytics.
features: Ten code types, no account needed: links, plain text, Wi-Fi (including hidden networks), contact cards (vCard), email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, map locations and payments (PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Bitcoin, Ethereum). Every…

Twelve hosted pages (free account): a link list with social profiles, a contact page with "Save contact", a business page with hours, a restaurant menu, a coupon with a copyable code, an event with "Add to calendar", a…
Live preview everywhere: a sticky preview on tablet and desktop, and an always-visible thumbnail bar with a Download button on phones.
Scan check: contrast, inverted colors, logo coverage and data density are checked as you edit. The rendered code is then decoded with a real QR reader, so "Verified scannable" means exactly that.

Make it yours: scan-safe color presets, linear and radial gradients, separate corner colors, transparent backgrounds, six pattern styles, five corner styles and five corner centers, frames with a "Scan me" call to…
